'''Barbarians''' are attackable [[Fremennik]]s found in the [[Barbarian Village]] and [[Barbarian Outpost|Outpost]]. They are commonly fought for training by lower level players due to their low Defence and the many obstacles in the Barbarian Village usable as [[safespots]]. If the player chooses to talk to them, they will taunt the player with quotes such as "Wanna fight?" or "You come to fight, ja?" and immediately attack; players can avoid this by immediately exiting the dialogue instead of clicking to continue.

[[Gunthor the brave|Gunthor the Brave]], a unique barbarian, is the strongest barbarian found in the village at level 29. Different [[Barbarian (Barbarian Camp)|barbarians]] can also be found in the [[Barbarian Camp]] in the [[Kourend Woodland]].
